activity.note: Sport teacher — on her feet all day. Beach volleyball and cycling on top. Trains 7 days a week: 2 interval runs, 2 zone 2 runs, 1 hybrid, 2–3 strength. AG 40–44. Three HYROX finishes. Careful: the load is already very high — redirect it, don't add to it.

goals: your weakest component in both races — the lever
hold your pace coming off the lunges
Lunges #172 and Burpee Broad Jump #187 — already strong

habits.name: Sleep 8h
habits.desc: With 7 sessions a week and a physical job, sleep is the limiting factor.

habits.name: Protein 1.6–2 g/kg
habits.desc: Spread across the day, not all at dinner.

habits.name: Eat enough
habits.desc: Teaching all day plus training: under-eating is the real risk, not over-eating.

habits.name: Forearm and wrist mobility
habits.desc: Your race is decided by grip. Look after it daily.

habits.name: Mobility 10 min
habits.desc: Shoulders and thoracic spine, for the overhead work.

plan.label: Week 1 — test week

days.main: Easy 40 min Z2. Nasal breathing for the first 20 min.
days.sub: Nothing hard today. Three test sessions this week and they only mean something if you arrive fresh.

days.main: TEST 1 · COMPROMISED RUNNING. Warm up 15 min. Then: 1 km hard. Rest 4 min. 1000 m Row at race effort. Then straight into a second 1 km, no break. Cool down 10 min.
days.sub: Send me all three times. The gap between the two kilometres is the number I need — it sets every running pace for the next twelve weeks.
days.pre: Warm up properly: 10 min easy + 4 × 20 s strides

days.main: PULL AND GRIP · Ring row 4×10 · Pull-ups 4×max (band if needed) · Farmers carry 4×40 m @2×16 kg · Pullover 3×12 · Hanging knee raise 3×10 · R90"
days.sub: Your four weakest stations all come down to pulling and grip. This session is the answer to that, and it repeats every week from here.

days.main: TEST 2 · ERGOMETERS. Warm up 10 min easy. 1000 m Row all out. Rest 8 min, fully recovered. 1000 m SkiErg all out. Cool down 10 min.
days.sub: Race distance, not 500. Send me both splits and your average pace per 500 m.
Recovery day between two tests. Keep it genuinely easy.

days.main: TEST 3 · GRIP, then a short hybrid. A) Farmers carry @2×16 kg — walk until you have to put them down. Record distance and time. Rest 10 min. B) 3 rounds: 500 m Row + 15 wall balls + 200 m run. R2' between rounds.
days.sub: Part A is the one I care about. Don't pace it — walk until your hands give out.

days.main: Rest, or an easy walk. Beach volleyball is fine if you feel like it.

plan.nutr:
Nothing to change this week. Eat normally around the tests — a bad test on an empty stomach tells us nothing.

Send me the numbers as you go, not all at the end. I'll build the twelve weeks around them.

presets.name: Grip and pull
presets.note: Your weak cluster in one block. Farmers, SkiErg, Row and Sled Pull are all the same problem wearing different clothes.

presets.name: Goblet squat — unbroken builder
presets.note: Session 1: no metronome, plain stopwatch — that sets your baseline pace. From then on the metronome runs at your previous pace +2 and you match every rep to the beep.

presets.name: Push press — unbroken builder
presets.note: Same protocol. Push press punishes a broken rhythm more than squats: if you speed up early you will stall around rep 40.

presets.name: Both weak stations — race rhythm
presets.note: The pair back to back, as they come in the race. Hold the cadence even when it feels slow at the start.

presets.name: Grip circuit
presets.note: No metronome on the carries — the stopwatch is enough. On the deadlifts, keep the beep: that is where rhythm saves you time.
